details: The U.S. Central Command confirmed airstrikes against Iran following an attack on a commercial vessel. In retaliation, Iran officially announced a navigation ban in the crucial Strait of Hormuz. Despite this escalation, market fears were somewhat eased after President Trump indicated a willingness to negotiate. Bitcoin showed limited immediate volatility, trading around $63,800, and is being closely watched as a real-time indicator of risk sentiment while traditional crude oil markets prepare to open.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate with Strikes & Strait Closure, Trump Signals Talks

details: Spot cryptocurrency Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) collectively recorded $282 million in net inflows. This marks an end to an eight-week period of continuous outflows, signaling a stabilization in institutional investor sentiment and providing a positive indicator for the broader cryptocurrency market.
title: Crypto ETFs Break Outflow Streak with Significant Inflows
